mapper.sql: SELECT w.*, c.user_id AS chapter_user_id, c.name AS chapter_name, c.category AS chapter_category, c.priority AS chapter_priority, c.mastery AS chapter_mastery FROM wrong_question w LEFT JOIN knowledge_chapter c ON c.id = w.chapter_id AND c.user_id = w.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND mastered = #{mastered}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wrong_question(user_id, title, content, correct_answer, my_answer, error_reason, chapter_id, review_count, mastered, next_review_date) VALUES(#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{correctAnswer}, #{myAnswer}, #{errorReason}, #{chapter.id}, #{reviewCount}, #{mastered}, #{nextReviewDate})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wrong_question WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
